description.value:
Duration constant

Distance is a kind of mercy. Mostly yours.

Your thrown Grafts’ range increment increases from 30 feet to 60 feet, and you do not take the −2 circumstance penalty for throwing a Graft while an enemy is adjacent to you.

cinderfall.incomplete: The range-increment increase (30 ft -> 60 ft) is built above, directly matching the real pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/alchemist/level-1/far-lobber.json shape (same key/mode/property triple, definition swapped for this class's own item traits since far-lobber's real definition, item:base:alchemical-bomb, doesn't apply to fleshmancer's own Grafts). "No -2 circumstance penalty for throwing while an enemy is adjacent" is unbuildable: pf2e's engine does not automate a ranged-adjacency penalty at all for any weapon (confirmed via a source grep of the character/action code), so there is nothing for a feat to negate.
